from qiskit import Aer
from qiskit_aer import AerSimulator
from qiskit_algorithms import VQE
from qiskit_algorithms.optimizers import COBYLA
from qiskit_nature.second_q.drivers import PySCFDriver
from qiskit_nature.second_q.mappers import ParityMapper
from qiskit_nature.second_q.transformers import FreezeCoreTransformer
from qiskit_nature.second_q.problems import ElectronicStructureProblem
from qiskit_nature.second_q.circuit.library import HartreeFock, UCCSD
from qiskit_nature.second_q.properties import ElectronicEnergy
import numpy as np

def vqe_h2_sto3g_stretched():
    # Define the molecule geometry
    molecule = 'H 0 0 0; H 0 0 1.5'
    driver = PySCFDriver(molecule=molecule, basis='sto3g')
    problem = ElectronicStructureProblem(driver, transformers=[FreezeCoreTransformer(freeze_core=True)])
    
    # Obtain the electronic structure problem
    electronic_energy = problem.second_q_ops()[ElectronicEnergy]
    
    # Map the problem to qubits
    mapper = ParityMapper()
    qubit_op = mapper.map(electronic_energy)
    
    # Initialize ansatz
    num_particles = problem.num_particles
    num_spatial_orbitals = problem.num_spatial_orbitals
    initial_state = HartreeFock(num_spatial_orbitals, num_particles, mapper)
    ansatz = UCCSD(
        num_spatial_orbitals,
        num_particles,
        mapper,
        initial_state=initial_state
    )
    
    # Set up the VQE
    optimizer = COBYLA(maxiter=500)
    backend = AerSimulator()
    vqe = VQE(ansatz, optimizer, quantum_instance=backend)
    
    # Run the VQE
    result = vqe.compute_minimum_eigenvalue(qubit_op)
    
    # Calculate the ground state energy estimate
    ground_state_energy_estimate = result.eigenvalue.real
    
    # Reference energy from PySCF
    reference_energy = driver.run().electronic_energy.total_energy
    
    # Calculate the energy error
    energy_error_against_reference = abs(ground_state_energy_estimate - reference_energy)
    
    # Check if chemical accuracy is achieved
    chemical_accuracy_achievement = energy_error_against_reference < 1e-6
    
    # Calculate measurement cost
    measurement_cost = result.cost_function_evals
    
    # Get the number of qubits
    qubit_count = qubit_op.num_qubits
    
    # Calculate circuit depth
    circuit_depth = ansatz.decompose().depth()
    
    # Calculate gate count
    gate_count = ansatz.decompose().count_ops()
    
    return {
        "ground_state_energy_estimate": ground_state_energy_estimate,
        "energy_error_against_reference": energy_error_against_reference,
        "chemical_accuracy_achievement": chemical_accuracy_achievement,
        "measurement_cost": measurement_cost,
        "qubit_count": qubit_count,
        "circuit_depth": circuit_depth,
        "gate_count": gate_count
    }
